The draft keeps product selection open, treats local confirmation as authoritative, and rejects offline confirmation queues. It also flags the [announced LibreBooking security release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreBooking/librebooking/64335703927fc73160ab6ff543d02db8ac4014a3/README.md) and a recurrence risk corroborated by its [current source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreBooking/librebooking/64335703927fc73160ab6ff543d02db8ac4014a3/Web/scripts/recurrence.js).

The native Goal reports **17m 23s elapsed** and **261,711 tokens used**. The binding check and single-use plan-release helper passed. No application tests, live data checks, installations, or deployments were run.
